summary: Zhongchao Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting a best-efforts public offering priced on May 29, 2026, seeking $5 million gross proceeds. The offering consists of units at $0.54 per unit, each including one Class A ordinary share (or a pre-funded warrant) and one warrant with a $0.594 exercise price, exercisable within six months. The pre-funded warrants have a nominal exercise price of $0.008 per share. The offering is conducted under an effective F-1 registration statement, with Univest Securities as placement agent receiving 7% cash fee plus expenses. Investors have a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional $5 million. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
